question:
Select the word that is opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the word given below.

Sinister
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Propitious'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **word that is opposite** in meaning (antonym) to the given word **"Sinister"** is** "Propitious".**
 
• **"Sinister"** means giving the impression that something harmful or evil is happening or will happen.
 
• It's derived from the Latin word "sinister" meaning 'left' or 'unlucky'(अनिष्ट)
 
• **"Propitious" **means giving or indicating a good chance of success; favorable.(अनुकूल)
 
• This word, therefore, represents a positive or favorable outcome, which is the exact opposite of "sinister". 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Propitious'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **"Baleful" **means threatening harm; menacing. (हानिकारक)
 
• **"Foreboding" **means a feeling that something bad will happen; anxious apprehension. (अपशकुन)
